name: delegate
description:
Send work to another agent or ask another agent a question. The receiving agent acts on the message immediately.

WHEN TO USE
- delegate: you want another agent to act, respond, or continue a task
- reply: you are posting a result silently to an upstream session — no action needed from the receiver
- question: you need input from the human user

RETURN-PATH CONTRACT
If your session context shows "Reply to session ID: ses_xxx" and you are delegating async, forward that same ID as reply_to. Breaking this chain is a runtime error.

agent.description: Target agent name as an exact match from the available agent list; required unless session_id alone identifies the target.

session_id.description: Existing target session ID to message and trigger; mutually exclusive with session_type.

session_type.description: Type of new session to create for the target agent. worker=short-lived job, scope=project-scoped session, role=long-lived agent session, scratchpad=temporary throwaway session. Requires agent. Mutually exclusive with session_id.

title.description: Human-readable name for the new session. Recommended when using session_type — without it the session gets an auto-generated title. Has no effect when session_id is provided.

prompt.description: Message, request, or agent-directed question that should trigger the target agent to act or answer.

description.description: Short log label for the delegation, used for tracking in UI/history.

reply_to.description: Session ID where the target agent should silently post results/status with reply; required when mode is 'async'.

mode.description: Delegation mode. 'sync' blocks until the agent replies inline. 'async' fires without blocking; the downstream agent posts results via reply to reply_to. Inferred from reply_to if omitted: async when reply_to is set, sync when not.

result_schema.description: JSON Schema object describing the expected structure of the result. For sync delegations the result is parsed as JSON and validated. For async delegations the schema is injected as a hidden instruction so the downstream agent knows what format to reply with.

intercepting.description: Set to true to explicitly opt in to intercepting the upstream return path when your session has an upstream replyToSessionID and you are intentionally routing reply_to to your own session. Without this flag such routing throws a contract violation error.

skills.description: Skill names to preload into the new session before the prompt is posted. Each skill's tools are added to the session's allowed toolset and the skill content is injected into the prompt — the downstream agent has full skill context from the first turn. Only applies when creating a new session (session_type or self-delegation). Cannot be used with session_id.
